verdict.rationale: Logseq's official docs describe a plugin dashboard where third-party plugins from the Marketplace can be searched, installed, updated and removed. They also document loading unpacked plugins distributed outside the marketplace, and community-maintained plugin API docs exist. Community comments imply its ecosystem is smaller than Obsidian's but do not contradict that the marketplace works. Missing for 10: evidence of catalog size/breadth (the 'large' part), independent hands-on corroboration of browsing and installing plugins.
